summary: Full E2E verification of the FOURTH redesign — Old World Mysuru / 1920s editorial gazetteer aesthetic. Backend regression suite: 8/8 pytest tests PASS against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (health, events register valid + 422 missing + 422 invalid phone, list registrations + filter, contact valid + 422 invalid email). Frontend: all 8 routes load with their data-testid='page-*' (/, /rampura, /temple, /hayagreeva, /mantra, /gallery, /events, /visit). Editorial design verified visually: aged-paper #F0E7D2 canvas, deep ink #1A1410 body, crimson #9B2C2C accent, Italiana display + EB Garamond body, drop-caps, sepia photo-vignettes, double-rule dividers, № numbering, dark-inverted shrine banner with cream text. CONTENT FIX VERIFIED — site-wide grep: 'Balanjaneya, the giver of knowledge' is NOT present anywhere; 'Beside the historic Balanjaneya' is NOT present anywhere; 'Beside the historic Doddaanjaneya' is present in BOTH Home ShrineBanner (line 349 of Home.jsx) and Temple Hayagreeva teaser (line 257 of Temple.jsx). Forbidden draft text ('Doc 1', 'Doc 2', 'older booklet', 'verify before publishing') is absent from every rendered route. Header layout verified: split nav (4 left / 4 right) with centered Tilak logo, masthead reads exactly 'The Rampura Gazette' under the tilak with 'ಶ್ರೀ ಬಾಲಾಂಜನೇಯಸ್ವಾಮಿ' subline; exactly ONE 'Directions' link with MapPin icon — no duplicate Visit label. Home hero: 'Sri Balanjaneya / Swamy' in massive Italiana display, drop-cap 'F' on the 'For centuries…' paragraph, the before/after Anjaneya diptych is present and prominent. № numbering verified on home (announcements show '№ 1', '№ 2', '№ 3' and blessings show '№ 1'..'№ 6'). RSVP form submission: POST /api/events/register returned 200, data-testid='rsvp-success' shown. Contact form submission: POST /api/contact returned 200, data-testid='contact-success' shown ('Your message has reached us.'). Gallery: 7 tiles (gallery-item-0..6), lightbox opens (gallery-lightbox). Mobile menu (390x844): mobile-menu-toggle opens mobile-menu listing all 8 bilingual nav links. READABILITY contrast sampling: hero/body/section samples all measured 14.90:1 ratio (deep-ink on aged-paper). 24 elements measured <3.0 ratio but spot-checks show these are decorative gold-on-cream label text ('Swift as the mind…' italic on gold-old in the stotra ribbon, ribbon decorations, and other small caps labels with deliberate sepia-on-cream styling) — none are body copy.
action_items: (Optional content-consistency check) /app/frontend/src/lib/data.js line 124 — EVENTS[0].descr still reads 'Three-day consecration of the new Vidya Hayagreeva shrine alongside the historic Balanjaneya garbhagudi.' The user's correction explicitly retargeted the shrine-adjacency line to 'Doddaanjaneya' (since the new sanctum is being raised beside the larger 9-ft Dodda Anjaneya). For consistency with the corrected Home/Temple wording, consider changing 'alongside the historic Balanjaneya garbhagudi' → 'alongside the historic Doddaanjaneya garbhagudi' here too. This appears in the events listing on /events and on /temple events strip. Not a hard requirement (the user's exact request was 'Beside the historic …'), flagging for editorial consistency only.
critical_code_review_comments: Hydration warning on /events persists from iteration 3: build-time x-source instrumentation injects <span data-ve-dynamic='true'> inside <option> elements in the RSVP event select. HTML disallows <span> as a child of <option>, React logs hydration mismatch. Not user-visible but should be quieted before production — likely a build-tool / x-source-instrumentation bug rather than app code.
Backend POST endpoints (/api/events/register, /api/contact) return 200 on resource creation instead of 201 — convention nit, non-blocking.
CORS allow_origins still defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True in backend/server.py — browsers reject this combo at runtime; set CORS_ORIGINS explicitly for production.
Backend persists created_at as ISO string and reparses on read in list_event_registrations — works but native BSON datetime would be cleaner.
Layout.jsx StotraRibbon: marquee renders 2 copies of the line; ensure CSS animation is paused for prefers-reduced-motion users (a11y nit).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — every requested testid, route, content correction, form flow, gallery, mobile menu and header element verified

test_credentials: N/A — no auth on this app.
seed_data_creation: Pytest and Playwright runs created several TEST_-prefixed event registrations and contact messages in MongoDB. Safe to leave or purge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py (8 tests, all green) — runs against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. CRITICAL form testid naming convention on this app: inputs use *-input suffix (e.g. rsvp-name-input, contact-email-input) and submit buttons use *-submit-btn (e.g. rsvp-submit-btn, contact-submit-btn). Success banners use bare *-success (rsvp-success, contact-success). Header brand has TWO link testids — brand-link (mobile) and brand-link-center (desktop, hidden on <xl screens) — masthead text 'The Rampura Gazette' lives inside brand-link-center. Mobile nav links are mobile-nav-{label} with 8 entries. Gallery has 7 items, lightbox is data-testid='gallery-lightbox'. The Reveal IntersectionObserver wrapper means off-screen elements start at opacity:0 — always scrollIntoView before measuring contrast or asserting visibility.
rca of the issue: No bugs found this iteration. The fourth redesign successfully replaced the previous warm-anthracite palette with the 1920s editorial gazetteer aesthetic. The user's specific content correction ('Beside the historic Balanjaneya' → 'Beside the historic Doddaanjaneya') is correctly applied at both required locations (Home ShrineBanner + Temple Hayagreeva teaser). The only remaining editorial inconsistency is in EVENTS[0].descr in data.js which uses similar but not-identical phrasing ('alongside the historic Balanjaneya garbhagudi') — flagged as optional follow-up for the main agent.
